pool.label: Mathematical methods in the biological/life sciences
Mathematical modeling and analysis in the physical sciences
Numerical analysis and methods of computational mathematics

children.note: The tracker only checks that you have four of these courses, not that they fall in two areas.
children.devNote: APPROXIMATE. Bulletin: choose two of five focus areas and take at least two courses within each (4 total). The engine can't express 'two areas with two courses each', so this is one COUNT (min 4) over the union of the five areas' courses, drawn as five labeled groups (pool entries in the bulletin's area order). Mathematical analysis is an OR_EQUIVALENT slot (MA 511 or 411; 511 first, so a student with both keeps MA 411 unclaimed) plus a COURSE_LIST (412, 512) marked `continues` so the UI draws them as one area. MA 573 is in both the biological and physical groups; a course is only claimed once, so it counts once (the first group claims it). MA 411 is excluded from the additional courses below. `subtitle` replaces the generated 'Pick N of M'. Exact modeling needs an engine node that counts groups, e.g. COUNT_GROUPS { groups: [{ label, pool }], minGroups: 2, minPerGroup: 2 }.
children.subtitle: Choose two areas below and take at least two courses in each.

atLeast.label: At least one of these numbered 500 or above

children.devNote: Bulletin: 'Four additional courses numbered 200 or above. At least one of these must be numbered 500 or above.' atLeast subset for the 500+ course. MA 411 is excluded so it can never count as one of these (at most one of 411/511 may be used for the track; a student who used 511 in a focus area and also has 411 can't double-count it). Side effect: MA 411 can't count as an additional course even when 511 isn't used. Ranges run to 999 (graduate courses allowed by 'numbered 200 or above').
